evidence.note: observeSweepGitState pairs an unreliable worktree list with mainWorktreePath None and never parses a holder from failed or truncated output. Reliable observations still admit None or Some(path).

The same observer sets mainCheckedOutElsewhere from probeUnreliable(worktreeList) OR held-by-another-worktree, and the class contract says an unreliable probe forces the boolean it feeds. Supported fixtures keep unreliable with mainCheckedOutElsewhere true (truncated probe rail and the no-path handoff); none construct unreliable with that flag false.

notes: Correction of r29-yeet-sweep-worktree-probe-address: same owner gains mainCheckedOutElsewhere. Two booleans plus path absence/presence is 8; legal rows are the four reliable path/flag pairs plus unreliable/None/true. branchCheckedOutElsewhere stays out because yeet-sweep-plan.test.ts constructs unreliable while leaving that flag false.

disqualifier.note: Separate git observations on SweepGitState. Ancestry, bun.lock diff, and whether another worktree holds the swept branch are written from different probes and fixtures set each combination, including merged-false with lockfile-true and branch-held alone. worktreeProbeUnreliable does not force branchCheckedOutElsewhere in the supported handoff fixture, so that flag is not part of the probe/path/main-checkout cluster.
